visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a montage of various colorful luggage tags and cosmetic products in a bright retail setting. A woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail is shown walking into a stationery store with wooden shelves and white counters. (2) Inside 'itoya,' the woman examines leather goods and pens arranged in glass cases. Colorful ribbons and personalized notebooks are featured in close-ups. (3) The scene shifts to 'ACE,' showing rows of suitcases in pastel and metallic colors. The woman opens a yellow suitcase to reveal a floral interior pattern. (4) At the 'CREED' perfume counter, a staff member sprays fragrance onto a tester strip. The main character smells the perfume with a pleasant expression. (5) Moving to 'clé de peau BEAUTÉ,' a high-end display of lipsticks and foundations is shown. The woman sits at a vanity for a hand-skincare consultation. (6) At 'YOJIYA,' rows of traditional oil-blotting papers and hand creams are displayed. The woman feels a soft colorful towel. (7) A large department of women's shoes is shown, featuring brands like Steve Madden and many 'Made in Japan' labels. (8) At 'kirei terrace,' rows of organic skincare bottles are highlighted. (9) The final section shows 'Romance no Mori Cafe,' featuring Matcha cakes and a hot dog meal. The woman sits by a window with a clear view of the white and red Kyoto Tower.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Subtitle]: 京都不只古色古香 好逛的東西也超級多. [Slogan]: 留言「京都」索取電子優惠券. (2) [Variety]: 今天來分享 京都站週邊 好逛櫃位8選. (3) [Subtitle]: 1 itoya伊東屋. 這間是關西地區最大間的伊東屋 文具控們請必訪. 店內文具用品很多 還有伊東屋原創商品 及京都店限定商品. 這區 Note Couture 可以客製化專屬筆記本喔. (4) [Subtitle]: 2 ACE. ACE的行李箱很多是日本製 外箱堅固外 內裡還超可愛. 實用的包包也很多. (5) [Subtitle]: 3 CREED. CREED是手工製作的百年香氛品牌 日本櫃點非常少，京都只有這裡有賣. 味道偏中性，男女皆可用 好喜歡這純白色的、超想入手. (6) [Subtitle]: 4 clé de peau BEAUTÉ. 肌膚之鑰也是每去必買 因為價差真的很大. 一對一服務很讚 在這買還能再95折 比機場的免稅價更划算. (7) [Subtitle]: 5 YOJIYA. 京都美妝伴手禮 首選就是YOJIYA 吸油面紙和護手霜都很適合. 現在多了可愛的週邊 很值得來逛逛唷. (8) [Subtitle]: 6 女鞋區. 在日本買鞋太值得 很多大牌子都有得買. 價格划算之外 還很多是日本製. (9) [Subtitle]: 7 kirei terrace. 喜歡自然系有機類保養品 請一定要來kirei terrace. 品牌非常多、很好買. (10) [Subtitle]: 8 ロマンの森カフェ. 這間是由京都北山MALEBRANCHE經營的 有名的茶之葉餅乾就是他們的唷. 店內有各式糕點之外 還有有人氣的熱狗捲心派. 逛街累了想吃點輕食+甜點 很適合來這邊坐坐. 面窗的座位，還可以欣賞京都塔. (11) [Subtitle]: 買完絕對要記得退稅 現在很多地方都改機器退稅 方便又快速. 今天分享的櫃位 都在京都站直通的 JR京都伊勢丹. 你們下次到京都 也去逛逛吧.
